title: FBI Says China-Linked Hackers Ran Portal Giving Third Parties Access to Stolen Emails
summary: Hackers tied to a Chinese cybersecurity company stole email from government organizations, law enforcement agencies, healthcare systems, and religious institutions in Southeast Asia, the FBI and agencies in 6 other countries said on October 8.
